newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Inverban maintains buy rating on Santander.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Inverban maintains buy rating on Santander.

text.p: Spain's Inverban brokerage said on Wednesday it was maintaining its buy rating on shares of Banco Santander after the leading bank reported its 1996 net profits in line with expectations.
Santander reported on Tuesday net attributable income rose 13.5 percent to 85.60 billion pesetas in 1996.
Inverban said Santander had managed in-line earnings despite an unexpectedly low contribution of 24.61 billion pesetas from Banesto.
"With Banesto profits in line with expectations (31 billion pesetas), Banco Santander net profits would have reached 88.8 billion pesetas," the note said.
Inverban said with earnings growth estimated at 16.6 percent it did plan to change its forecasts for the group and continued to recommend it as a buy at medium risk.
Inverban said it expected loan quality to improve in 1997, with improved profitably as measured by return on equity and return on assets.
The dividend is also expected to rise.
"In 1997, we expect Banco Santander to pay a total 350 pesetas gross per share, 13 percent more than on 1996 results," the note said.
